description: Baseline capability for the main window. Least-privilege: only core defaults are granted in Stage 1. Filesystem, dialog, and updater permissions are added with the commands that need them in later stages (docs/08 §2, docs/16). The five core:window grants are exactly what the custom title bar needs and no more: `start-dragging` backs data-tauri-drag-region (core:window:default covers the double-click path via allow-internal-toggle-maximize, but NOT the drag), and minimize/toggle-maximize/unmaximize/close back the three window buttons. Deliberately absent: set-position, set-size, set-decorations, set-always-on-top and every other mutation the UI never performs.
